Israeli minister threatens citizenship for Gaza documentary directors

An Israeli minister has threatened to strip Israeli directors of their citizenship over a documentary about Gaza that won an award at the Venice Film Festival. The documentary, titled 'NAZA', focuses on the Gaza Strip. The minister's specific threat was directed at the directors of the film.
